## Overview

This project analyzes FAO Food Balance Sheet data to understand long-term trends in food availability, consumption, and trade patterns across countries.

## Objectives

- Track changes in dietary patterns over time
- Identify countries at risk of food insecurity
- Analyze the impact of trade on food availability

## Methods

- Data collection from FAOSTAT
- Panel data analysis
- Visualization dashboards

## Outputs

- Annual reports on food security trends
- Interactive dashboards
- Policy briefs
